policy.integration: One sdeveng plugin only. Upstream plugins remain separately installable references and are never bundled as additional toolkit plugins.
policy.context: Use decision records as routing metadata; load an upstream skill or compact local reference only after a narrow trigger.
policy.vendor: Repository guidance forbids vendoring upstream .NET skill content, so VENDOR_UNCHANGED and VENDOR_OPTIMIZE are intentionally unused.
policy.install: Do not install the entire upstream marketplace. Select a pinned upstream plugin only for an explicit task that benefits from it.

decisions.trigger: Exact platform detection, bounded test execution, filter translation, or MTP watch behavior.
decisions.referenceLoading: Keep filter syntax lazy after detection; never load all four for routine verification.

staticCost.scope: Four skills, about 43.7 KB/6.1K words before references.

decisions.deterministicParts: Detect projects/platform, construct commands, capture exit/results and normalize bounded output in AgentTool.
decisions.jevSuitableParts: None for identity, filters, pass/fail or watch state.
decisions.gptExpertValue: Explain framework filters and diagnose the first causal failure after structured evidence.
decisions.rationale: The toolkit already owns targeted execution; a parallel orchestrator would duplicate routing.

decisions.trigger: Coverage, CRAP score, or source-to-test correlation is explicitly requested.
decisions.referenceLoading: Load reporting guidance only after formats and installed tools are detected.

staticCost.scope: Three skills plus six references and three mixed-language scripts exceed 100 KB.

decisions.deterministicParts: Parse coverage formats, calculate metrics and correlate source/test candidates in AgentTool.
decisions.jevSuitableParts: Rank a large sanitized candidate set only after exact metrics; never calculate coverage.
decisions.gptExpertValue: Judge whether uncovered behavior matters and propose boundary-focused tests.
decisions.rationale: The useful core is deterministic and mixed-language helpers conflict with the single .NET executable architecture.

decisions.trigger: Explicit review of adequacy, assertions, gaps, smells, grading, or categorization.

decisions.deterministicParts: Collect assertions, names, coverage and mutation evidence before review.

decisions.gptExpertValue: Relate tests to behavior and design discriminating cases.
decisions.rationale: Expert taxonomies are useful but overlap heavily; one compact lazy reference preserves the high-signal checks.

decisions.deterministicParts: Discover repository style/framework and execute generated tests.
decisions.gptExpertValue: Generate conventional tests with behavior-discriminating assertions.
decisions.rationale: Valuable on demand but too broad and multi-language to absorb.

staticCost.scope: Four skills total roughly 67 KB/9.3K words.

decisions.deterministicParts: Inventory calls, consumers, public changes and validation results.
decisions.jevSuitableParts: Only screen a large sanitized candidate list.
decisions.gptExpertValue: Judge seams, compatibility and staged refactoring tradeoffs.

decisions.deterministicParts: Collect duplication and mock-setup candidates.

decisions.gptExpertValue: Interpret confounders and preserve build correctness.

licenseStrategy.current: The toolkit stores facts, paths and original analysis only; no dotnet/skills implementation or substantial documentation is copied. Attribution lives here and in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
licenseStrategy.ifVendored: Vendoring is prohibited. If policy changes, preserve the upstream MIT license/copyright with every substantial copied portion, record exact commit/path and mark modifications.
licenseStrategy.releaseCheck: Before release, confirm no upstream skill bodies, scripts, agents or references entered the archive; otherwise stop and update notices and source provenance.
